title: Please Stop Putting 14 Buttons on One Card
excerpt: A card is not a cockpit. Pick the one thing it's for.
body:
Building a shared component library forces a question most screens never ask: what is this component actually for?

If the answer needs a list, it's two components. If every action is primary, none of them are.

Constraints in the library are a feature. They make the next hundred screens consistent without a single design review.
